import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

out = Path(__file__).parent / 'evidence' / 'batch54-home-probe'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
auth_source = Path(os.environ.get('CODEX_HOME', str(Path.home() / '.codex'))) / 'auth.json'
assert auth_source.is_file(), 'Existing authentication file unavailable'
probe_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='yavo-batch54-home-'))
probe_env = dict(os.environ)
env_keys = ['HOME', 'CODEX_HOME', 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'XDG_STATE_HOME', 'XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'TMPDIR']
for key in env_keys:
    probe_env[key] = str(probe_root)
for key in ['OPENAI_API_KEY', 'CODEX_API_KEY']:
    probe_env.pop(key, None)

def scrub(value):
    value = re.sub(r'(?i)(Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+', r'\1[REDACTED]', value)
    value = re.sub(r'\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+', '[REDACTED_KEY]', value)
    value = re.sub(r'(?i)("(?:access_token|refresh_token|id_token|api_key)"\s*:\s*")[^"]*', r'\1[REDACTED]', value)
    return value

report = {'schema': 'yavo-batch54-home-probe/1', 'participant_sessions': 0,
          'requested_environment_keys': env_keys, 'all_environment_directories_equal': True,
          'copied_files': ['auth.json'], 'original_environment_unchanged': True,
          'api_key_environment_removed': True, 'authentication_file_contents_recorded': False}
try:
    shutil.copyfile(auth_source, probe_root / 'auth.json')
    (probe_root / 'auth.json').chmod(0o600)
    marker = probe_root / 'write-check'
    marker.write_bytes(b'writable')
    marker.unlink()
    report['temporary_directory_writable'] = True
    report['initial_directory_entries'] = sorted(p.name for p in probe_root.iterdir())
    report['cli_version'] = subprocess.check_output(['codex', '--version'], text=True).strip()
    argv = ['codex', 'exec', '--ephemeral', '--skip-git-repo-check', '--sandbox', 'read-only',
            '--json', '--output-last-message', str(out / 'final.txt'), '-']
    report['argv'] = argv
    start = time.monotonic()
    proc = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=probe_root, env=probe_env, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    timed_out = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = proc.communicate(b'Return exactly READY. Do not call tools or inspect files.\n', timeout=45)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
    report.update(elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start, exit_code=proc.returncode, timeout=timed_out)
    stdout_text = scrub(stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    stderr_text = scrub(stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    (out / 'stdout.jsonl').write_text(stdout_text, encoding='utf-8')
    (out / 'stderr.txt').write_text(stderr_text, encoding='utf-8')
    events = []
    for line in stdout_text.splitlines():
        try:
            event = json.loads(line)
            if isinstance(event, dict):
                events.append(event)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    completed = [event for event in events if event.get('type') == 'turn.completed']
    report['event_types'] = [event.get('type') for event in events]
    report['usage'] = [event.get('usage') for event in completed]
    report['ready'] = proc.returncode == 0 and bool(completed) and all(isinstance(e.get('usage'), dict) for e in completed)
    report['stderr_error_lines'] = [line for line in stderr_text.splitlines() if any(t in line.lower() for t in ['error', 'failed', 'read-only'])][:20]
    report['created_entry_names'] = sorted(p.name for p in probe_root.iterdir() if p.name != 'auth.json')
    for name in ['stdout.jsonl', 'stderr.txt']:
        raw = (out / name).read_bytes()
        report[name] = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(probe_root)
    report['temporary_authentication_copy_removed'] = True
    (out / 'probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')

print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
